jobs.title: .NET Developer | Senior
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join an IT team in the banking sector, supporting systems used to monitor trading activity, strengthen compliance controls and identify potential fraud or operational anomalies. This opportunity is based in Porto, in a hybrid work model, and focuses on back-end development, data-oriented analysis, application modernization and software robustness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Develop, maintain and optimize back-end applications supporting monitoring, control and compliance-related processes.
- Contribute to the modernization of existing systems, including architecture improvement, technical upgrades and robustness initiatives.
- Design and improve database components, including complex stored procedures, views and data structures.
- Support the implementation of automated testing frameworks to increase application quality and maintainability.
- Apply secure development practices and contribute to DevSecOps adoption within the software delivery lifecycle.
- Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders in an agile environment to analyze requirements and deliver reliable solutions.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 6 to 9 years of professional experience in .NET development, with strong autonomy in complex application environments.
- Proven ability to improve application robustness, maintainability and technical architecture.
- Analytical mindset, with the ability to understand data flows, business rules and operational control requirements.
- Initiative, ownership and the ability to contribute to modernization and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Professional working proficiency in English, minimum B2 level.
- Collaborative, responsible and solution-oriented approach aligned with agile delivery practices.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

- C#
- .NET
- .NET Framework
- SQL
- Database architecture
- Complex stored procedures and views
- RESTful APIs
- SOLID principles
- Design patterns
- Automated testing frameworks
- Agile methodologies
- DevSecOps practices

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in compliance, anti-fraud, trading, financial markets or control-oriented systems.
- Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices applied to software development.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Private health insurance from day one, with no waiting periods and optional family extension.
- Access to confidential mental health support, content and live sessions through TEAM 24.
- Continuous training and certification opportunities to support structured professional growth.
- Flexibility whenever the role and project context allow it, supporting sustainable performance and daily balance.
- Team moments, shared milestones and leadership presence that strengthen collaboration and belonging.
- Upskilling opportunities in quality management, information security, AI governance and cybersecurity best practices.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Hexa is committed to equal opportunity and inclusive hiring. We value different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and we align our practices with the principles of the Portuguese Diversity Charter.

HEXA LIFE

At Hexa, every professional is a Builder. You will be part of a culture based on honesty, mutual support and agility, where people are encouraged to contribute, improve and build meaningful solutions together.

jobs.title: Associate, Software Developer Full Stack
jobs.description:
Requisition ID 36613

Office Country Bulgaria

Office City Sofia

Division Information Technology

Contract Type Fixed Term

Contract Length 3 years

Posting End Date 26/10/2026

About The Platform

The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is building a next-generation Client-Led Procurement (CLP) platform hosted on Microsoft Azure. The platform digitises procurement workflows across bankers (internal), clients, and external participants through four dedicated Angular portals backed by a microservices backend on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). The architecture follows a strict Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) pattern: an API Management ingress layer, persona-specific BFF composer services, and independently deployable domain services.

What You’ll Do

As an Associate Full Stack Developer you will contribute to both the frontend Angular portals and the backend Spring Boot microservices that power the CLP platform. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team, taking features from specification through design, implementation, testing, and deployment on AKS. The role spans the full stack across all services on the platform.

Key Responsabilities

Design, implement, and maintain backend domain microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Build and enhance Angular single-page applications for the Internal, Client, Participant, and Public portals.
Implement and document RESTful APIs following OpenAPI/Swagger standards; contribute to API-first design reviews.
Work with the Azure data tier: Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, and Cosmos DB.
Write and maintain Liquibase database migrations; ensure schema safety across environments.
Author unit, integration, and contract tests (JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test, Pact) and maintain coverage gates.
Containerise services with Docker and support deployment on AKS via Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and threat-modelling sessions.
Contribute to observability: structured logging (Logback/Logstash), distributed tracing (Application Insights), and SLO dashboards.
Operate within EBRD engineering standards including SonarQube quality gates, SAST/DAST scanning, and branch policies.

Need To Have — Your Essentials

Backend — Java / Spring Boot

Java 21+: proficient in modern Java features — records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads
Spring Boot 3.x+: REST controllers, JPA/Hibernate, validation, actuator, autoconfiguration
RESTful API design: OpenAPI 3 / Swagger; resource modelling, versioning, error contracts
Azure Database for PostgreSQL: JDBC, JPA mappings, PostgreSQL SQL dialect, index-aware query design
Multi-module Gradle builds: buildSrc convention plugins, version catalogues (libs.versions.toml)
Testing: JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test (@SpringBootTest, @DataJpaTest), Mockito; targeting 80 %+ coverage
Git: branching strategies, pull-request-based workflow, code review

Frontend — Angular / TypeScript

Angular 21: components, services, reactive forms, RxJS, signals, Angular Router, lazy loading
TypeScript: strict mode, interfaces, generics, decorators
REST API consumption: HttpClient, error handling, interceptors, environment configuration
HTML5 / CSS3: responsive layouts, WCAG accessibility awareness
State management: NgRx or equivalent reactive state pattern

Cloud & Platform

Microsoft Azure: working knowledge of AKS, Azure Storage, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Key Vault, and Managed Identity concepts
Docker: Dockerfile authoring, multi-stage builds, container image best practices
CI/CD: experience with any major pipeline tool (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins); automated build → test → deploy flow
Observability basics: structured logging, correlation IDs, health endpoints (Spring Actuator)

Architecture & Ways of Working

Microservices / SOA: service decomposition, bounded contexts, API contracts between services
Security awareness: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC fundamentals, token validation, least-privilege data access
Agile / Scrum: sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, Definition of Done
Code quality: SOLID principles, clean code, peer review, static analysis

Nice to Have

The following skills are advantageous but not required at hire; you will develop many of them on the job.

Azure Platform (Advanced)

Azure Blob Storage — SAS token issuance, lifecycle policies, blob versioning
Azure Service Bus — AMQP messaging, topics/subscriptions, dead-letter queues, idempotent consumers
Azure API Management (APIM) — inbound/outbound policy authoring, JWT validation, rate limiting, CORS
Azure Entra ID / B2C — OIDC flows, custom policies, app roles, SCIM provisioning
Azure Application Insights / Monitor — distributed tracing, workbooks, alert rules
Azure Front Door / Application Gateway / WAF

Kubernetes & Infrastructure

AKS — pod lifecycle, HPA, PodDisruptionBudgets, namespace isolation
Helm — chart authoring, values overrides, release management
Workload Identity / Managed Identity on AKS — federated credential binding, RBAC scoping
Terraform — IaC for Azure resources, state management, module patterns

Data & Integration

Cosmos DB — SQL API or MongoDB API, partition key design, RU/s governance
Liquibase — changeset authoring, rollback strategies, multi-environment safety
GraphQL — schema design, query/mutation authoring, Apollo or Spring GraphQL
Azure Application Insights — distributed tracing, dependency tracking, performance monitoring, and alerting

Workflow & Quality Engineering

Camunda 7 or 8 — BPMN modelling, external task workers, compensation patterns
Contract testing — Pact (consumer-driven), provider verification in CI
SonarQube / Jacoco — quality gate configuration, branch/PR analysis
SAST / DAST / dependency scanning — integration in CI pipelines

Why You’ll Love This Role

Exposure to a modern, greenfield Azure-native platform built from first principles.
Work across the full stack — Angular portals, Spring Boot domain services, AKS, and Azure data services.
Collaborative, high-trust engineering culture with strong code-review and architecture practices.

What is it like to work at the EBRD? / About EBRD

Our agile and innovative approach is what makes life at the EBRD a unique experience! You will be part of a pioneering and diverse international organisation, and use your talents to make a real difference to people's lives and help shape the future of the regions we invest in.

At EBRD, our Values – Inclusiveness, Innovation, Trust, and Responsibility – are at the heart of how we work. We bring these to life through our Workplace Behaviours: listening well and speaking up, collaborating smartly, acting decisively with full commitment, and simplifying to amplify our impact. These principles shape our culture and define our success. We seek individuals who not only share these values but are also committed to embedding them in their daily work, fostering a positive and high-performing environment.

The EBRD Environment Provides You With

Varied, stimulating and engaging work that gives you an opportunity to interact with a wide range of experts in the financial, political, public and private sectors across the regions we invest in.
A working culture that embraces inclusion and celebrates diversity. Our workforce reflects a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, bringing fresh ideas, energy, and innovation and enhancing our ability to serve our clients, shareholders, and counterparties effectively.
We offer hybrid and flexible working arrangements and believe we operate at our best when collaborating 3 days a week in person (minimum).
An environment that places sustainability, equality and digital transformation at the heart of what we do.
A workplace that prioritises employee wellbeing and provides a comprehensive suite of competitive benefits.

Diversity is one of the Bank’s core values which are at the heart of everything it does. As such, the EBRD seeks to ensure that everyone is treated with respect and given equal opportunities and works in an inclusive environment. The EBRD encourages all qualified candidates who are nationals of the EBRD member countries to apply regardless of their racial, ethnic, religious and cultural background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, socio-economic background or disability.

Please note, that due to the high volume of applications received, we regret to inform you that we are unable to provide detailed feedback to candidates who have not been shortlisted (for further consideration).

jobs.title: Digital Factory - Senior Software Engineer (Backend) - Assistant Director
jobs.description:
Build a Better Working World with EY Digital Factory

At EY, we’re committed to shaping the future with confidence. As part of our Digital Factory team, you’ll work at the intersection of technology and innovation, helping to deliver cutting-edge solutions that transform businesses globally.

This is your opportunity to take on a leadership-oriented technical role, guiding backend engineering practices while remaining hands-on in building secure, scalable, and reliable services that power EY’s digital platforms.

The Opportunity

As a Assistant Director - Backend Engineer
, you will:

Lead the design and development of APIs, data access layers, and integrations.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical decision-making.
Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Frontend, and Data teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
Drive best practices in coding, security, and observability across the team.

What We’re Looking For

Agility and Growth Mindset: Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Technical Leadership: Experience guiding teams and influencing architecture decisions.
Collaboration and Inclusivity: Building trust and fostering diverse perspectives.

Qualifications

9+ years of professional experience in backend development, with at least 3 years in a leadership or mentoring capacity.
Expertise in building backend services and APIs using .NET/C# or Python.
Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code reviews.
Working knowledge of Azure Cloud, containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
Familiarity with messaging and event streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).
Solid understanding of security fundamentals and observability practices.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
Fluency in English. Any additional language(s) are highly appreciated.

Preferred Skills

Experience with microservices, DDD, CQRS, and event-driven architectures.
Exposure to GraphQL, gRPC, API gateways.
Performance optimization and caching strategies (Redis).
Background in regulated environments or financial services.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep).
Proven ability to lead distributed teams and drive technical excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership: Guide design reviews, mentor team members, and enforce coding standards.
Service & API Development: Architect and implement robust APIs and backend services.
Quality & Reliability: Ensure high test coverage, implement CI/CD, and maintain observability.
Security & Compliance: Apply secure coding practices and support audits.
Continuous Improvement: Drive automation, reduce operational toil, and improve developer experience.

What’s In It For You

Accelerate your technical and leadership capabilities through EY’s learning programs.
Collaborate with global teams in a diverse and inclusive environment.
Access continuous investment in your well-being and career development.
Shape the future of digital innovation at EY.

Recruitment Process

HR Screening
Technical Interview
Leadership Interview

Ready to lead and innovate? Apply today.

To ensure an inclusive recruitment experience, please share any disability-related adjustments you may need.

EY
| Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
